retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic layout featuring a central group portrait framed by bold diagonal stripes and massive, overlapping display typography.
excludeWhen: vertical or horizontal grid alignment is preferred
modern thin sans-serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition where a rectangular group photograph is anchored in the lower center, intersected by a series of thick diagonal bands in black and grey. A massive, vibrant red display word dominates the upper third, partially overlapping the dark diagonal band.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal stripes create a sense of upward movement and depth
Oversized text overlaps the background elements to unify the top half
The central photo acts as a stable anchor against the dynamic background
High contrast between the white negative space and the dark diagonal bands
coreInvariants: Extreme scale of the primary display text
Rectangular framing of the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A rectangular group portrait is centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick black diagonal band across the top third provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal stripes from top-right to bottom-left, then settles on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of clean white space at the bottom and top-left corners balance the heavy graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and Charcoal Grey (diagonal stripes and clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (primary typography and selective clothing highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation red against low-saturation neutrals (black, white, grey).
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, white, and two shades of grey

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are scaled to fill the width of the canvas

composition.relationshipToImage: sits above the central photo frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face paired with small, technical metadata fonts in the corner.
graphicDevices: Thin rectangular border around the photo
Small circular logo emblem in the bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, sharp-cornered aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary visual weight and impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean white background with three thick diagonal stripes (black, dark grey, light grey) running from the top right toward the middle left. Place a rectangular frame in the lower center for a group portrait.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in massive, extra-bold red geometric sans-serif across the top third, ensuring it overlaps the black diagonal stripe.

verificationChecks: Is the red text massive and overlapping the stripes?
Are the diagonal stripes consistent in angle?
Is the central photo framed by a thin black line?
Is there sufficient white negative space at the bottom?

adjustableVariables: Color of the primary accent (red can be swapped for blue or yellow)
Number of subjects in the central portrait
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is the most prominent element
Check that the diagonal stripes do not obscure the faces in the photo
Verify the white space provides a clean 'modern' feel despite the retro style
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Diagonal Stripe Background] + [Oversized Geometric Typography] + [Framed Group Portrait] to create a high-impact retro promotional layout.
